title: Energy Vault Appoints IPP Industry Vet Cory Magnuson as President of Asset Vault, Announces Expansion of Financing Platform to Support Massive Demand in AI Compute Infrastructure Solutions
summary: Energy Vault names Cory Magnuson as President of Asset Vault to enhance financing solutions for AI compute infrastructure amid rising demand.
body_markdown: *Magnuson brings 20 years of deep capital formation and structured finance experience within the Independent Power Producer (IPP) and energy infrastructure sectors, most recently as the CFO of Spearmint Energy*
